t.zh: 识别网络要 S×S 的输入，照片却有各种宽高。手上的缩放元件能把任何图缩成任何尺寸。这一关的问题是：网络要 512×512，手里是 768×512 的照片，直接缩放到 512×512 可以吗？
t.en: A recognition network wants S×S input, while photos come in every width and height. The resizers in hand can bring any image to any size. This level asks: the network wants 512×512 and the photo is 768×512 — can it be resized straight to 512×512?

t.zh: 测试图里画着一个正方形的东西：交出的 S×S 图里，它还得是正方形。结果里每个像素都来自照片，不留空边；它的中心对准照片的中心，对不准时偏左上半个像素。横幅和竖幅的照片都要成立。
t.en: The test images hold something square, and in the S×S result it must still be square. Every pixel of the result comes from the photo, with no empty borders, and it is centred on the photo's centre, half a pixel towards the top-left where it cannot be exact. It must work for landscape and portrait photos alike.

after.zh: 宽与高之比叫<wiki-ref to="aspect-ratio"></wiki-ref>：宽高各缩各的会改变它，圆变成椭圆；OpenCV 的尺寸写成 (宽, 高)。
after.en: Width over height is the <wiki-ref to="aspect-ratio"></wiki-ref>: scaling width and height separately changes it and turns circles into ellipses; OpenCV writes a size as (width, height).

brief.zh: 输入一张照片和边长 S：交出 S×S 的图，照片里的正方形在图里仍是正方形，画面居中。
brief.en: Given a photo and a side S, give an S×S image, centred on the photo, in which squares stay square.

hint.zh: 宽和高乘同一个数，宽高比才不变。
hint.en: Only multiplying width and height by one number keeps their ratio.

hint.zh: 缩放和裁剪都要整数的宽高。
hint.en: Resizing and cropping both need whole-number sizes.

solution: c = crop(r, x0, y0, S, S)
